title: Barton and Cuenca honored at international social science conference
summary_en: Keith Barton received the 2026 Irving Morrisett Award for Excellence in Social Science Education, while Alex Cuenca was the opening speaker of the conference’s plenary session, “Borikén Social Studies: Reflections on the Estándares de Contenido y Expectativas de Grado en Estudios Sociales in Puerto Rico.”
